{{Quote|Surely you've followed events at Glova, Glom Tho and Druckenwell? The Empire no longer exists, and its warlords are in retreat throughout the Trailing Sectors.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]] occurred not long after the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nantz]] was given command of the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]], tasked with operations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. He staged his campaign from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] after the end of the Nagai-Tof War.<ref name="TEGTW" />

From there, Nantz took the First at [[Glova]]&mdash;assisted by [[New Republic Army|ground forces]] commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tyr Taskeen]]&mdash;forced [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus|Delvardus]]' military into retreat from the [[Glova system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

The capture of Glova cut Delvardus off from potential reinforcements from Imperial forces stationed further down the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
